eventCalendar.exportHint: Download a one-off copy for your calendar. This does not create a registration or subscription. A file already imported does not update automatically.
eventCalendar.waitlistExport: Your request is waiting. The file marks it as tentative and does not confirm a place.
eventCalendar.cancelledExport: The file marks this event as cancelled. Copies already imported are not changed automatically.
eventCalendar.demoFile: This demonstration file describes a fictitious event in this browser.
eventCalendar.prepared: The iCal file was prepared for download.
eventCalendar.downloadFailed: The file could not be prepared. Try again from the event while it remains accessible.
eventCalendar.agendaLead: View your personal events and your registrations for association events.
eventCalendar.demoAgenda: This demonstration shows only your fictitious association registrations in this browser.
eventCalendar.paginationHint: Browse each list with “Show more”. Events are split by their start time when this agenda was opened; events that have started may still be in progress.
eventCalendar.emptyUpcoming: No accessible upcoming association registration in this list.
eventCalendar.emptyHistory: No accessible association registration for an event that has started in this list.
eventCalendar.truncated: Other events may be missing from this list. Also check the relevant association pages.
eventCalendar.empty: No accessible association registration in your agenda yet.
